note: Explainable: linear weights over character n-grams, bge-base embedding dimensions, amount, sign and channel show what drove each category. Operations: CPU only (scikit-learn + ONNX bge-base, about 130 MB), about 12k rows/s per process and 2.1 GB peak at 20k-row batches; retraining one configuration takes about 14 minutes on a laptop CPU. Known issue: on unseen merchants Travel is the fallback guess (30% of rows, nearly all wrong, confidence about 0.5); FR-5 review and feedback retraining are the remedy.
